tags.description: First usable version of a new product

tags.name: Prototype / proof of concept
tags.description: Quick test build to prove an idea

tags.name: Rescue / takeover
tags.description: Took over or fixed someone else's broken or unfinished work

tags.name: Extend existing product
tags.description: Added features to a live product

tags.description: Rebuilt or moved an existing system to a new stack or platform

tags.description: Planning, architecture or advisory work before or instead of building

tags.name: AI powered
tags.description: Baseline tag, almost every job has it, so it carries no matching weight

projects.name: Navience
projects.overview: An AI powered healthcare platform that automates prior authorization and utilization management for payers, MSOs and delegated IPAs. It reviews requests in real time against clinical and payer criteria, auto approves clear cases, escalates edge cases to nurses or medical directors, and keeps a full audit trail of every AI decision.

projects.name: Open Dental AI Calling (Chloe)
projects.overview: An AI calling system for dental practices built on Retell AI and integrated with Open Dental, running the Chloe voice agent. It handles patient calls and follow ups such as booking, recall and reminders, and writes results back to the practice system.

projects.name: DentalMasteryDynamics
projects.overview: A HIPAA compliant, multi tenant AI analytics SaaS for dental practices built on an OpenDental integration. It tracks KPIs such as case acceptance, hygiene utilization and schedule efficiency, and sends a daily AI review of the actions that matter most.
projects.case_study_summary: Built a HIPAA compliant, multi tenant AI SaaS platform that turns dental practice data into daily decisions on case acceptance, hygiene utilization and schedule efficiency. Secure OpenDental integration syncs appointments, patients and financials, and a configurable KPI engine recalculates show rates, case acceptance, schedule utilization, hygiene reappointment and collections nightly. A daily AI review sends only anonymized KPI numbers to the LLM, with RAG grounded in dental coaching playbooks, so recommendations are practical and PHI is never exposed. Managers can text a Twilio SMS assistant or call an AI voice hotline for live KPIs and coaching, with human escalation on request, while an admin panel tracks subscriptions and cross clinic performance. Encryption, tokenized sessions and BAAs were built in from day one, making compliance a sales advantage.

projects.name: DentAI Call
projects.overview: DentAI Call is Stackup's productized AI voice receptionist for dental practices, sold under the agent name Chloe. It verifies patients, books, reschedules and cancels appointments in the practice management system, sends payment links, routes emergencies and transfers to staff, with a NestJS backend and Next.js admin panel.

projects.name: ManyPartsMinistries
projects.overview: The ManyParts Dashboard is the single system of record for Many Parts Ministries, replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools. It manages users, roles, enrollments and assessments across thousands of users, with organization hierarchies, coupons and funnel analytics.
projects.case_study_summary: Built the ManyParts Dashboard from the ground up as the single system of record for Many Parts Ministries, replacing spreadsheets, PDFs and disconnected tools across thousands of users, enrollments and assessments. The platform covers user and role management, enrollment and assessment tracking with funnel analytics, a three level parent and child organization hierarchy with merging, and an organization linked coupon engine. A form submission engine creates and updates users, organizations and coupons automatically, with ClickUp task creation and Easyship shipment integrations wrapped in database transactions with rollback protection, plus cron based data reconciliation after migrating years of messy historical records. An AI Ministry Assistant uses RAG over assessment documents with OpenAI embeddings, Pinecone and streaming responses. Stack: React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, PostgreSQL. Results: about 70% less admin workload, far fewer data errors and support tickets.

projects.name: GlowUpHub
projects.overview: A SaaS platform for salon owners that turns salon documents into an AI assistant for staff. Owners register, create staff logins and upload their documents, so staff get instant answers to repetitive questions instead of asking the owner, with a website crawl module added to grow the knowledge base.

projects.name: Rock County Sealcoat automation
projects.overview: An end to end business automation platform for a sealcoating company, from first call to completed job. An AI phone agent captures leads 24/7 into Bitumio CRM, and an admin dashboard handles weather aware scheduling, route planning, customer confirmations and live GPS tracking.

projects.name: SargeAI
projects.overview: A jurisdiction aware AI legal intelligence platform on web, iOS and Android that helps law enforcement officers find approved legal authority and draft court ready affidavits. Answers come only from approved case law, statutes and department policies, with citations on every source.
projects.case_study_summary: Built Sarge AI, a jurisdiction aware AI legal intelligence platform on secure web and iOS and Android that helps law enforcement officers find approved legal authority and draft court defensible affidavits without hallucinations. Strict RAG gating answers only from approved, published case law, statutes and department policies, cites every source and refuses when authority is insufficient. The affidavit workflow takes typed, uploaded or dictated facts, asks structured follow up questions, checks probable cause and jurisdiction, drafts language without altering officer facts and flags gaps or potentially unlawful actions. Officers get OTP and biometric onboarding, cited voice and text chat and a scene perimeter tool, while departments get single tenant isolation, a document approval lifecycle, role based access, daily review of flagged answers and immutable, CJIS aligned audit logs. Delivered over 6+ months and prepared for a 5 department pilot.

projects.name: Seller Genius AI
projects.overview: A multi tenant SaaS platform that replaces manual cold calling for realtors and small brokerages with AI voice agents. Agents set up their own AI caller, import leads, and the system qualifies leads, books appointments and follows up automatically.
projects.case_study_summary: Built Seller Genius AI, a multi tenant SaaS platform that replaces manual cold calling for solo realtors and small brokerages with AI voice agents that qualify leads, book appointments and follow up automatically. Each agent personalizes an AI caller with name, greeting, tone, working hours and buying and selling preferences, then adds buyer, seller or investor leads by form or Excel import. A cron and queue driven call engine places outbound calls through SignalWire, tracks every call state in real time, retries unanswered leads, and uses GPT-4 to write transcript summaries, while agreed meetings land automatically in Google Calendar. Dashboards show leads, conversion, appointments and call history, with Stripe subscriptions and usage tracking. Stack: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS. Results: 1 to 2 hours saved per agent per day, 15 to 35% more booked appointments and 10 to 30% fewer lost leads.

projects.name: Orionlease
projects.overview: An AI document intelligence platform for a commercial real estate acquisition group that turns long, complex leases into structured acquisition data. It runs OCR on scanned files, extracts a defined lease schema with Claude, and keeps every field traceable and human approved.
projects.case_study_summary: Designed and built an AI document intelligence platform for a commercial real estate acquisition group that turns long, complex leases into structured, human approved acquisition data. Users organize deals and properties, upload base leases, amendments and broker data tapes, and scanned files are routed through Azure Document Intelligence OCR. Claude on AWS Bedrock extracts a defined lease schema where every field returns a value, source, confidence and supporting language, honoring amendment hierarchy, while a separate AI pass over flags deal threatening clauses such as termination rights, co-tenancy, guaranty limits, ROFR and go dark rights. Extractions are reconciled against non standard broker spreadsheets as Green, Yellow or Red variances, reviewed through a role based confirm, correct or flag interface, and exported as standardized abstracts and variance reports. Stack: React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Celery and Redis. Built to compress a 3 to 5 day review across portfolios of 90+ properties.

projects.name: Innspeed
projects.overview: A B2B SaaS platform that gives independent and boutique hotels in Europe an AI guest communications layer they can launch in under fifteen minutes. Hotels embed an AI chat widget and connect WhatsApp Business, and the platform answers guests in six languages, drives direct bookings and runs campaigns from one inbox, built GDPR ready.

projects.name: Apex
projects.overview: An AI CRM and lead intake system for Apex Windows, a window repair and replacement company. A Retell AI voice agent and website chatbot capture and qualify every inquiry 24/7, a custom CRM dashboard manages leads and follow ups, and QuickBooks invoicing handles deposits and job payments.

projects.name: MiDocRD
projects.overview: Holadoc (MiDocRD) is a two sided healthcare marketplace for the Dominican Republic that connects patients with verified doctors. Patients search doctors by specialty, price and insurance, send appointment requests and chat in real time, while doctors are verified and manage requests from their dashboard.
projects.case_study_summary: Took Holadoc (MiDocRD) from idea to a live two sided healthcare marketplace for the Dominican Republic that connects patients with verified doctors. Patients browse and filter doctors by specialty, price, availability and accepted insurance without signing up, then register at the point of intent to send appointment requests and chat in real time over Socket.IO with PDF and image sharing. Doctors go through a document based verification pipeline before becoming discoverable, manage availability and appointments, and convert from a freemium tier to unlimited Stripe subscriptions, with usage limits enforced in the workflow and reset monthly. Reviews come only from real appointments and pass admin moderation, and a Super Admin layer governs verification, subscriptions, appointments and ratings. Bilingual English and Spanish, built with React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO and Stripe.

projects.name: CaboAirportShuttle
projects.overview: A real time mobile and web operations platform for Cabo Airport Shuttle that replaced Google Sheets. It coordinates 150+ airport transfers a day across drivers, representatives and admins, with QR code ride verification and live status updates.
projects.case_study_summary: Built a real time mobile and web operations platform for Cabo Airport Shuttle that replaced Google Sheets and now coordinates 150+ airport transfers a day across 70+ drivers, representatives, mechanics and admins. Website bookings carry QR codes that drivers or representatives scan on arrival for instant verification, with fallback search, and representatives assign verified rides to available drivers while status updates push live through Pusher. Drivers log hours, ride completion, cash or card payments and tips, and submit vehicle maintenance requests that mechanics schedule and track per vehicle. Admins see active rides, driver availability and payments with manual overrides and a full audit trail, and a real time Google Sheets sync keeps accounting in familiar tools. Stack: React Native, Laravel, MySQL, Pusher, OneSignal, JWT. Launched in 3 months and scaled over 2+ years, with far fewer missed rides and faster payment reconciliation.

projects.name: Fierana (Women Learning Platform)
projects.overview: Fierana is a subscription learning platform for women that guides each member through a personalized pathway. Onboarding assessments assign an archetype and starting level, and the platform delivers video lessons, practice tracking, live Zoom classes, community and automated email journeys, with Stripe billing.

projects.name: Tolba
projects.overview: A privacy first, women only matchmaking app for serious marriage in the Middle East, built in Flutter for iOS and Android with an admin portal. Every account is ID verified, applications are anonymous until a mutual identity reveal, and chats are time bound and moderated, in Arabic and English.

projects.name: Taleroo
projects.overview: A multi tenant AI career integration SaaS that helps migrants, refugees and job seekers in Germany reach funded training, coaching and language programs. A multilingual AI intake builds personal career strategies and matches users to eligible programs and providers.
projects.case_study_summary: Designed and engineered Taleroo, a live, multi tenant AI career integration SaaS that helps migrants, refugees and unemployed people in Germany reach funded training, coaching and language programs. A multilingual conversational intake in six languages captures employment status, goals, qualifications, language level and support needs, and AI generates 1 to 3 step career strategies combining DeuFöV and IntV language courses, FbW further education and AVGS-MAT coaching, all validated by deterministic funding rules. A Red, Yellow and Green Ampel system scores eligibility readiness with human moderation. Students get a hub with Kaltura learning videos, tasks, coaching bookings, document uploads, chat and video via Stream.io, while providers manage courses, enrollments, contract templates with signatures and AZAV audit preparation. Stack: Next.js, Flask, PostgreSQL, Firebase, AWS, PostHog. Delivered in about 6 months.

projects.name: AI heritage fence voice agent
projects.overview: A 24/7 AI voice agent for a nationwide US fencing company that answers, qualifies and books every inbound call across all US time zones. It routes emergencies to a human line, books live appointments without double booking, sends SMS and email confirmations, and gives managers a dashboard of calls and bookings.
projects.case_study_summary: Built a 24/7 AI voice agent on Retell AI for a nationwide US fencing company that answers, qualifies, schedules and escalates every inbound call across all US time zones. The agent detects emergency intent and routes urgent jobs to a human line, books appointments live during the call with a rule engine that prevents double booking, captures structured estimate details for the sales team, and sends SendGrid SMS and email confirmations with multi stage reminders and round robin salesman assignment. A secure React admin dashboard gives managers calendar views, call logs and AI captured metadata. Stack: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS. Results: 80% call pickup rate, 30% more booked appointments, 2 to 3 hours saved per day for office staff, and no more emergency jobs lost to voicemail.

projects.name: Verify Script
projects.overview: VerifyScript is a monetized AI web app, launched in six weeks, that helps patients, caregivers and providers find hidden risks across multiple medications. Users enter or photograph their medications, and AI flags drug and food interactions in clear, shareable reports.
projects.case_study_summary: Built and launched in 6 weeks VerifyScript, a monetized AI web app that helps patients, caregivers and providers uncover hidden risks across multiple medications. Users enter prescriptions, OTC drugs and supplements manually or by photo, with Google Vision OCR and RxNorm normalization and autocomplete turning messy inputs into structured data. GPT-4 then identifies drug to drug and drug to food interactions, prescribing cascades, deprescribing opportunities to discuss with a provider, monitoring markers and recent recalls, under guardrails that keep outputs educational, anonymized and never directive. Results are compiled into a branded PDF report with Puppeteer and emailed automatically through the Gmail API, with Stripe payment required before analysis and a follow up email after 3 days. Stack: React, Node.js, Express, OpenAI. The MVP signed its first paying users within the launch window.

projects.name: Image Summary App
projects.overview: A multilingual AI accessibility app for iOS and Android that helps Pashto, Dari and English speakers understand documents from a photo. It runs OCR, writes a short plain language summary and reads it aloud, delivered in three weeks.
projects.case_study_summary: Delivered in 3 weeks a multilingual AI accessibility app for iOS and Android that helps Pashto, Dari and English speakers understand documents from a photo. Users pick a language, capture and crop a document image, and the app runs OCR, generates a short, plain language summary with OpenAI gpt-4o-mini, and reads it aloud with OpenAI text to speech. The stateless, client side React Native and Redux architecture with no sign up or stored data kept the product fast, private and low cost, while user guided cropping improved OCR accuracy and concise prompts controlled hallucination and API spend. The MVP reduces reliance on human translators and lays the foundation for multi page documents, richer voice controls and broader language support.

projects.name: Paddlewar
projects.overview: A multi tenant league management platform for paddle and racket sports that has run in production for over two years. It replaces spreadsheets with role based access for players, admins and facilities, plus a custom scheduling engine for balanced league schedules.
projects.case_study_summary: Built PaddleWar, a production multi tenant league management platform for paddle and racket sports that has run for over two years, replacing spreadsheet driven operations across independent leagues. Strict data isolation and role based access serve players, league admins, organizations and facilities. A custom scheduling engine generates schedules on demand while balancing home and away games, court availability across facilities and mandatory rest periods. Stripe handles secure annual membership payments with refunds, partial seasons and cancellations, Google SMTP automates transactional and schedule notifications, and an asynchronous integration with an external AI engine recalculates player ratings after each match and updates standings. Built with Laravel and InertiaJS. Results: no more spreadsheet scheduling or payments, lower admin overhead, more player trust in schedules and ratings, and growth without a linear increase in staff.

projects.name: Playpickleball
projects.overview: A multi tenant tournament management SaaS for pickleball organizations. It handles player and team registration, payments and a round robin scheduling engine that builds full league schedules in under a minute based on availability and courts.
projects.case_study_summary: Built PlayPickleball, a multi tenant tournament management SaaS that lets sports organizations register players, schedule matches intelligently and run leagues with minimal manual effort. A custom round robin scheduling engine assigns matches by team availability, optimizes court usage by location and generates full league schedules in under a minute, with manual overrides for real world changes. Players and teams register and pay online through Stripe with automated Google SMTP confirmations, and each company gets its own isolated dashboard while a super admin sees the whole platform. Role based access covers company admins, league coordinators and players, with instant point based standings, rankings and revenue reporting per tournament. Stack: Laravel, Bootstrap, MySQL. Results: 80% less scheduling time, 50% less admin workload, 100+ tournaments, 5,000+ players and $1,500+ revenue per tournament.

projects.name: OnDemandPsych
projects.overview: A HIPAA ready AI psychopharmacology platform that helps psychiatrists build safer medication treatment plans in minutes. It answers from curated medical texts through RAG with an AI validation step and auditable outputs, alongside patient chats and subscription billing.
projects.case_study_summary: Designed and built a HIPAA ready AI psychopharmacology platform that helps psychiatrists finalize safer treatment plans in minutes. The product uses GPT-4 with Retrieval Augmented Generation over curated medical texts in Pinecone, with internal only citations, an AI validation agent in the loop and logged, auditable outputs to prevent hallucinations in high risk decisions. Clinicians get multithreaded patient chats, templates for SOAP notes, medication plans and labs, drug interaction and polypharmacy alerts, tapering and cross titration guidance, and ICD-10 verification with DSM-5-TR mapping. Built on Next.js and Laravel with AES-256 encryption, full audit logging, JWT auth and Stripe subscriptions. Impact: 10 to 18 minutes saved per consultation, 25 to 40% less workflow time and 15 to 30% fewer medication related errors.

projects.name: Puppeteer
projects.overview: A mobile first, multi tenant ticketing platform that gives event organizers control from ticket sales to gate entry. Organizers allocate tickets to sellers, track live sales and revenue, and scan tickets at the gate.
projects.case_study_summary: Designed and built Puppeteer, a mobile first, multi tenant ticketing platform that gives event organizers control from ticket sales to gate entry. Organizers create events and inventories, allocate tickets to individual sellers and adjust stock in real time, while live WebSocket charts show tickets sold, sales velocity and revenue by channel. Sellers request more inventory in app with instant OneSignal push notifications to organizers. One time QR codes with server side invalidation stop duplicate and fraudulent tickets and speed up scanning at the gate, and daily sales reports and downloadable data remove manual spreadsheet reconciliation. Stack: React Native for iOS and Android, Laravel and MySQL, VueJS admin panel, WebSockets. Results: faster entry, eliminated duplicate ticket use, real time revenue visibility and actionable post event insights.

projects.name: Glass Doctor
projects.overview: A secure internal AI knowledge assistant for Glass Doctor that gives employees instant answers from company policies, procedures and training documents. Admins upload files, OCR handles scanned pages, and a RAG pipeline keeps answers limited to approved material.
projects.case_study_summary: Built a secure, internal AI knowledge assistant for Glass Doctor that turns scattered policies, procedures, measurements and training documents into instant answers for employees. Admins upload PDFs and Word files, OCR extracts text from scanned documents, and a RAG pipeline chunks and embeds content into Pinecone so ChatGPT answers only from approved material and declines to guess when nothing relevant exists. The platform includes role based access for super admins, admins and employees, an in app document viewer, chat history, read only chat logs for auditing and a usage metrics dashboard. Built with Next.js, Node.js, MySQL and JWT authentication as a single tenant system. Results: employees get answers in seconds instead of waiting on calls, senior staff are interrupted far less, and new hires onboard faster through self service knowledge.

projects.name: Bitrix24
projects.overview: An AI WhatsApp support system for a residential property operator that answers tenant questions automatically. Tenants are identified by booking ID or phone, and answers come from apartment documents and live Bitrix24 CRM data, with handover to staff when needed.
projects.case_study_summary: Built an AI powered WhatsApp support system for a residential property operator that resolves tenant questions automatically using live booking data and apartment documents. Tenants message on WhatsApp, the system identifies them by booking ID or phone number, and GPT-4o answers from apartment specific PDFs indexed in Pinecone with fallback to global documents and Bitrix24 CRM data, so responses stay grounded and accurate. Failed verification or detected frustration triggers an escalation with full context, and admins can switch any chat between automatic and manual mode from a React dashboard. Built with Node.js, MySQL, AWS and the Meta WhatsApp Business API, hardened for check in and check out spikes. Results: about 90% of tenant queries resolved automatically, replies in 5 to 10 seconds, and human support reduced to exceptions only.

projects.name: Chairboss
projects.overview: An AI powered booking and business management platform for salons, barbers and other service providers on web and mobile. Clients find providers and book with real time availability or by voice, while providers manage clients, payments through Stripe Connect, loyalty rewards, revenue sharing partnerships and analytics.

projects.name: DocTrace.ai
projects.overview: DocTrace.ai is an AI document intelligence MVP for legal document review. It processes uploaded documents with OCR, extracts key information and lets users search and trace facts back to their source through a RAG pipeline built in Python on Azure and AWS AI services.

projects.name: The Village (IL Borghista)
projects.overview: IL Borghista is a travel and local discovery platform for Italian villages that connects travelers with municipalities, local businesses, events, experiences and products. Travelers search and explore on interactive maps, save favorites and submit itineraries, while businesses manage listings and admins moderate content.

projects.name: ShipperScout
projects.overview: ShipperScout is a freight marketplace MVP that connects shippers with carriers through requests for quote. Shippers post RFQs, a matching engine routes them to relevant carriers by route and service type, and carriers unlock leads with credits bought through Stripe subscriptions.

projects.name: StayPlus
projects.overview: An upsell engine for a short term rental operator that lets guests buy add on services such as early check in, late check out, parking and housekeeping. Services are assigned per property, eligibility is checked against live Guesty reservations, and guests pay through Stripe from their guidebook link or the StayPlus website.

projects.name: Breesy
projects.overview: Breesy is an AI automation platform made up of more than fifty AI agents, where each agent runs as its own SaaS product. The agents cover tasks such as lead generation, document processing, voice and workflow automation on a shared web and mobile platform.

projects.name: ZD Law Firm Automation
projects.overview: Workflow automation for Ziegler Diamond Law, a bankruptcy law firm, that removes manual post filing work. The system reads official bankruptcy forms, generates Suggestion of Bankruptcy pleadings for pending state cases, pre drafts reaffirmation packages for lenders and automates deadline alerts, built across Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel and Claude.

projects.name: 10-4 Global
projects.overview: An ongoing AI development engagement with 10-4 Global, a vehicle shipping and logistics company. Work covers an in house transport management system replacing Quote Factory, AI voice agents on Twilio and Retell AI, workflow automation, and ShipMyCar, a car shipping site with distance based pricing and subscription plans.

projects.name: Dealsmart
projects.overview: Deals Smart AI is a multi tenant SaaS platform for car dealerships that turns missed and dormant leads into booked appointments. It syncs leads and inventory from dealer CRMs and runs AI conversations over SMS and email, with Stripe billing and performance reporting.
projects.case_study_summary: Built Deals Smart AI, a multi tenant SaaS platform that turns missed automotive leads into booked appointments without growing dealership BDC teams. Webhook integrations with CDK Elead and Automotive Mastermind pull leads and intent scores in real time, inventory sync keeps the AI on in stock vehicles, and campaign templates for lease expiry, dormant and high intent leads run AI conversations over SMS and email. Strict guardrails stop the AI from inventing prices, availability or financing promises, while escalation rules notify reps and then managers when SLAs are missed. AI books appointments across rep calendars and dashboards track campaign and funnel performance. Stack: React, React Native, Laravel, MySQL, AWS, OpenAI with RAG, Twilio. Directional results: under 30 second first response, 20 to 35% more booked appointments and 1 to 2 hours saved per rep per day.

projects.name: LumiTrip
projects.overview: A mobile first AI travel concierge PWA that builds a complete day by day itinerary in about 10 seconds from destination, dates, budget and travel style. It supports six languages, including right to left layouts, and lets users regenerate whole plans or single sections.
projects.case_study_summary: Built LumiTrip, a mobile first AI travel concierge PWA that turns destination, dates, travel vibe, budget tier and language into a complete, day by day itinerary in about 10 seconds. Structured GPT-4 prompts produce consistent morning, afternoon and evening plans with dining, local recommendations and events in six languages including right to left layouts, and regeneration logic rewrites whole plans or single sections while preserving locked edits. Travelers edit inline, save favorites and share public itinerary links. Stack: React, Node.js with Express, PostgreSQL, OpenAI and JWT authentication. Early traction: 500 to 2,500 monthly users, 2,000 to 10,000 itineraries a month, 4 to 8 minute sessions, 30 to 45% repeat usage within two weeks, and 20 to 35% of itineraries leading to booking intent.

projects.name: ThreadLabStudio
projects.overview: A web based AI design SaaS that takes independent fashion designers from idea to factory ready apparel in minutes. Designers generate realistic garment mockups from prompts or artwork, with AI trend guidance and production ready exports.
projects.case_study_summary: Built ThreadLabStudio, a web based AI design SaaS that takes independent fashion designers from idea to factory ready apparel in minutes. Designers enter a prompt or upload logos and artwork, and AI blends them onto T-shirts, hoodies, jackets and pants with realistic folds, fabric textures and print placement, generating mockups asynchronously in 10 to 40 seconds with fast iterations. AI trend forecasting guides design choices, a tech pack creator turns mockups into editable, factory ready PDFs, and a manufacturer directory speeds handoff to production, all organized in one project and analytics dashboard with Stripe payments. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Supabase functions and database, OpenAI, Hugging Face and Replicate models. Results: design time cut from 2 to 6 hours to 2 to 10 minutes per mockup, with 1,000+ mockups created.

projects.name: Kruzee
projects.overview: A driving lesson platform that connects students with company managed instructors, built to scale from Canada into the US. Students book and pay for lesson packages on the web, and instructors manage schedules and lessons in a React Native mobile app.
projects.case_study_summary: Partnered end to end with Kruzee to design and build a vertically controlled driving lesson platform that connects students with company managed instructors, scaling from Canada into the US on one core architecture. Students book lessons quickly through a responsive, location based web experience with package based pricing and platform owned payments, while instructors use a React Native app for iOS and Android to view assigned lessons, manage availability and out of office time, and access student details. A centralized backend handles scheduling, pricing logic and payment orchestration, and an internal admin dashboard lets operations manage instructors, availability and payouts without engineering help. Results: a much faster booking flow than manual coordination, better instructor utilization and reliability, and operational control at scale without adding headcount, supporting hundreds of active students.

projects.name: Eye Clinic Management
projects.overview: An end to end clinic management platform for an eye clinic, made up of a React Native patient app and a web based clinician CRM on a shared backend. Patients book, pay, upload documents and manage appointments, while clinicians manage schedules, patients and services.
projects.case_study_summary: Designed and built an end to end clinic management platform for an eye clinic, combining a React Native patient app with a web based clinician CRM on a shared Node.js backend. Patients create accounts, browse services and pricing, book from real time availability, upload medical documents, pay securely through a tokenized payment gateway, and reschedule or cancel within clinic policy. Clinicians manage working hours, slots and blocked dates, see week and month calendars, track appointment states including no shows, and access a patient directory with history, documents, payments, refunds and automatically generated PDF invoices and receipts. The engagement covered workflow mapping, Figma UX, ERD and schema design, JWT authentication, QA and production deployment, giving the clinic one operational system from booking through billing with 24/7 patient self service.

projects.name: LexGuard Pro
projects.overview: An AI powered compliance SaaS for landlords and property managers, built from prototype to beta. It rates each property Red, Yellow or Green against jurisdiction rules, stores compliance documents in an evidence vault and tracks deadlines.
projects.case_study_summary: Built LexGuard Pro over six months from prototype to beta as an AI powered compliance SaaS for landlords and property managers. A property level Compliance Ledger rates each property Red, Yellow or Green from document health, deadlines and jurisdiction rules that admins manage as data, so new cities and states are added by configuration rather than new code. The Evidence Vault stores leases, rental licenses, lead certificates and inspections on AWS S3 with fingerprinting, timestamps and audit events, using OpenAI to assist document verification. A Gatekeeper hard blocks compliance sensitive actions such as filings when requirements are missing and explains why, every decision is logged for auditability, and court ready ZIP evidence packs can be generated. Daily scans raise alerts and webhooks before expirations, and data pipelines pull Maryland SDAT and Baltimore Housing records. Stack: Next.js, NestJS, MySQL, AWS S3, OpenAI.

projects.name: Lucid Vision
projects.overview: A cross platform mobile app that generates personalized meditation sessions in real time from each user's mood, goals and own words. It uses AI prompts per theme and memory across sessions so every session feels personal rather than scripted.
projects.case_study_summary: Designed and built Lucid Vision, a launch ready, cross platform mobile app that generates personalized meditation sessions in real time from each user's mood, goals and free text input. Category specific prompts on OpenAI gpt-4o-mini shape tone and structure for themes such as love, career, family and sports, while user summaries and embedding based memory carry personalization across sessions without static scripts. Sessions are paired with immersive background audio processed with ffmpeg, saved for later reflection, and tracked through PostHog analytics to refine the experience. Stackup led the UX, built around a calm, ritual first daily flow with emotionally safe language and low cognitive load. Stack: React Native, Redux, Supabase authentication and storage, OpenAI.

projects.name: Malaab
projects.overview: A multi tenant B2B2C sports facility booking platform that replaced phone, WhatsApp and spreadsheet bookings with one conflict free system. Players book slots, recurring sessions and tournaments with local payments in English and Arabic, while venues manage courts, pricing and availability.
projects.case_study_summary: Delivered Malaab end to end, a multi tenant B2B2C sports facility booking platform that replaced phone calls, WhatsApp messages and spreadsheets with one conflict free system. Players book single slots, recurring sessions or tournaments with real time availability, instant confirmation and a secure local payment gateway in English and Arabic with full right to left support. Court owners and academies manage availability, pricing rules and calendars from a React web portal, and admins oversee all tenants from a React Native app. A Laravel booking engine handles role based access, real time slot locking to prevent double bookings, configurable time slots, tournament and recurring logic, and payment orchestration tuned for peak hour traffic. Results: about 70% less manual coordination, better booking reliability and utilization, and daily active usage across venues, architected for regional and global expansion.

projects.name: Verkehrbox
projects.overview: An enterprise, multi tenant construction operations platform in Germany, built over about three years, that manages labor, materials, logistics and payroll across many sites and companies. Workers check in on mobile apps, and managers plan crews, track materials and feed accurate hours into payroll.
projects.case_study_summary: Partnered for about three years to design and build Verkehrbox, an enterprise, multi tenant construction operations platform in Germany that manages labor, materials, logistics and payroll across many sites and companies. Workers check in and out on iOS and Android, giving accurate time tracking per site, task and employer that feeds payroll workflows and reduces disputes. Managers plan labor with dedicated calendars for sites, teams and individuals, and material check in and check out gives shared inventory visibility across companies working on the same site. Strict role based permissions for workers, site managers, company admins and super admins let multiple firms collaborate with customized views on one central API, built for high concurrency at shift changes and years of accumulated data. Results: centralized real time visibility, far less manual coordination, more accurate payroll and stronger accountability.

rules.rule: Client already hired for this job
rules.details: Fails when the Hires count in Activity on this job covers all positions needed.

rules.rule: Client asks to move off Upwork, asks for logins or bank details, or wants unpaid test work
rules.details: A paid test is fine.

rules.rule: Client posted 2 or more similar jobs and interviewed no one
rules.details: Check the client's other open jobs and recent history.

rules.rule: Payment unverified, more than 3 jobs posted, and joined more than 7 days before posting
rules.details: All three must hold. An unverified client with 3 or fewer jobs posted, or who joined within 7 days before posting, is G6 instead.

rules.rule: Outside accepted regions, under $1,000 per hire, and not mostly long term
rules.details: All three must hold. A client outside the accepted regions who averages $1,000 or more per hire, or mostly offers long term work, is G7 instead.

rules.rule: Core work outside services, or standalone UI/UX or DevOps
rules.details: Judge the work from the description, not the skill tags. UI/UX design and DevOps are fine only as part of a from scratch build.

rules.rule: No clear scope

rules.rule: Avg hourly paid $20 or below, or not shown

rules.rule: Hire rate below 50%
rules.details: A new client with no history is only noted as "new client, no history", not flagged.

rules.rule: Client rating below 3.5
rules.details: No reviews yet is not a flag.

rules.rule: Payment unverified, rescued by new client fallback

rules.rule: Outside accepted regions, rescued by spend or long term work
rules.details: Rescued by averaging $1,000 or more per hire, or by mostly long term contracts.

rules.rule: No Stackup sample clearly matches
